name: A4 amendment (short-only SMDP, Codex final 2026-10-11)
unchanged: targets {0,-.25,-.5,-.75,-1}, 6 cells, maker 2 bps/side, kernel, stops, folds, scripted baselines, PASS criteria

waits.reason: wait head kept (user: RL chooses its decision cadence); action set narrowed

changes.network: 948 -> 64 Tanh -> 64 Tanh; heads target 5, wait 3, value 1 (65,481 params)
changes.gae: gamma_d = 2^(-dt/43200 m), lambda_d = 0.95^(dt/5 m), per decision
changes.rollout: each env collects until 7 calendar days of its own clock elapsed (last action completes; block-end truncation kept); no fixed decision count
changes.episodes: blocks [train_start + 90k d, min(train_start + 90(k+1) d, train_end)), non-overlapping, chronological, tail included; flat reset at block start; no random starts; min(10, n_blocks) envs per cell over the same block order; a finished env takes the next unconsumed block; after all blocks the cycle restarts
changes.entropy: normalized h_target = H/log5, h_wait = H/log3; betas applied to raw head entropies: u1-17 (.010,.020), u18-34 (.005,.015), u35-68 (.002,.010); h_wait < .55 -> next update beta_wait .05; back to the schedule after h_wait >= .60 twice in a row
changes.evaluation: training seeds {0,1,2} x action RNG seeds 10000..10007 = 24 sampled trajectories per cell (numpy Generator seeded (rng, seed, cell index)); score = min over cells of stitched F1..F3 mean net4 minus max(0, famvol, ewa); tie -> earlier; joint argmax per seed = diagnostic; all candidates <= 0 -> A4 FAIL and F4 skipped; else U* frozen, F4 retrain to U*, single 2025 evaluation with the same 24-sample method (MDD / bootstrap on the mean daily series)
changes.abort: nonfinite, ledger identity > 1e-8, long exposure, block overlap -> immediate abort; h_wait < .30 or sampled dominant wait share > .95 for 3 consecutive updates while beta_wait = .05 -> collapse FAIL; no performance early stop
changes.stop_diag_fix: position and day stop in the same minute count as one stop event (denominator)
